question: As of January 2022, which enterprise became India's first unicorn sports enterprise?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chennai Super Kings.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chennai Super Kings (CSK) **is a cricket franchise that participates in the **Indian Premier League (IPL).**
 
• As of **30 January 2022**, CSK became **India's first sports unicorn** with a market capitalization of** Rs. 7,600 crores.**
 
• A unicorn is a term used for a startup or a company that has a** valuation of over $1 billion**.
 
• CSK has been one of the **most successful teams **in the IPL, having won the tournament five times and reaching the finals eight times.
 
• The team is owned by** India Cements,** a company that is headed by former** BCCI president N. Srinivasan.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Patna Pirates:**

 
 
• **Founded**: 2014
 
• **Team Colors**: Green and White
 
• Patna Pirates have had notable players like **Pardeep Narwal**, one of the most successful raiders in the history of the PKL.
 
• Patna Pirates have won the **PKL title three times** (in 2016, 2017, and 2022), making them one of the most successful teams in the league.
 
 
 
• **Dabang Delhi:**
 
 
• **Founded**: 2014
 
• **Team Location**: New Delhi
 
• **Team Colors**: Red and Yellow
 
• Players like **Rishank Devadiga**, **Joginder Narwal**, and **Naveen Kumar** (who has been a star raider for the team).
 
• Dabang Delhi won their first **PKL title** in **2021**.
 
• They have been consistently strong contenders in the league, with a strong lineup of players.
 
 
 
• **Gujarat Giants:**
 
 
• **Founded**: 2016
 
• **Team Colors**: Orange and Black
 
• **Key Players**: Some of the key players include **Rahul Chaudhari** and **Ajay Kumar**.
 
• Gujarat Giants reached the final in **2017** and have had strong performances in the league, though they have not yet won the title.
 
• They are known for having a solid defense and a good team balance.
